independent_unit: one PKLSA-qualified carrier; resolution replicas and multiple carrier variants from one provider group are not independent cross-source votes
parser_contract: Consume only PKLSA v0.4.0 RELEASE.json records with schema PKLSA-HIGH-RES-QUALIFICATION-4 and publication_ready_geometry_layer=true. Admit carriers only from topologies whose qualification/summary.json has qualification_gate_pass=true. Carrier source_path may be text XYZ, NPZ, NPY, or JSON geometry. PKLSA-generated/derived carriers are retained for diagnostics but do not close X0 cross-source consistency.
translator_contract: Coordinates remain in carrier/source units during blind scoring. PKLSA topology_id, carrier_id, source_family, provider_group and source paths are HMAC-opaque in public outputs and retained only in the private reveal map. No SST length, density, circulation, particle identity, or mass calibration enters blind gates.

replication_policy.same_provider_multiple_carriers: collapse to one provider vote; disagreement becomes INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY
